blind_note: Judged from the blind manifest and the review images only. The answer key (which points are Module-1 predicted boundaries) was not viewed before these judgments were written and frozen.
operational_rules: Recorded while reviewing and before any reveal; applied to every point.
B requires the two frames to show different business contexts: a different application with unrelated content, or a different record clearly opened after the previous one ended.
An application switch whose visible content continues the same topic (a record and the procedure or memo for that same kind of work) is C, not B.
A requires the same context visible on both sides of the sampled moment with no completion or switch signal between the frames; visible work on the same record or document strengthens it.
A completion or switch signal between the two frames (a completion toast, an app-picker dialog) leaves open whether a new unit began, so it is C unless a different record is visibly opened.
An identifier that is cut off at the frame edge is not read; if it is decisive, the point is C.
Note text visible in a frame is never transcribed into a rationale.
pre_freeze_check: Before freezing, every rationale was re-read against its review image and reworded where it overstated what the frames show. No label changed in that check; one confidence changed (#37).
